== claude-global / create
block: "@~/.agents/kander/KANDER-AGENTS.md\n"
detect: ok=false detail=未发现 <HOME>/.claude/CLAUDE.md
ensure 1: status=1 removed=0 inactive=false disabled=[] target=<HOME>/.claude/CLAUDE.md
file after ensure 1: "@~/.agents/kander/KANDER-AGENTS.md\n"
ensure 2: status=0 removed=0 inactive=false disabled=[] target=<HOME>/.claude/CLAUDE.md
file after ensure 2: "@~/.agents/kander/KANDER-AGENTS.md\n"
detect after ensure: ok=true detail=<HOME>/.claude/CLAUDE.md
uninstall: action=1 path=<HOME>/.claude/CLAUDE.md reason="" content=""
== claude-global / create / apply uninstall
apply uninstall plan prompt: "kander uninstall 将处理全局范围：\n  删除  <HOME>/.agents/kander 中 1 个 Kander 规则文件和状态文件，随后删除变空的目录\n配置：在 <HOME>/.config/kander/config.json 中写入 install_rules: false，并删除所有 agents.<name>.install_rules。\n不删除：二进制、config.json、share 目录、缓存和看板。\n"
apply uninstall: err=false
apply uninstall output: "已关闭规则注入：<HOME>/.config/kander/config.json\n已删除 <HOME>/.agents/kander 中 1 个 Kander 规则文件和状态文件\n"
apply uninstall config: install_rules=false true
apply uninstall file <HOME>/.claude/CLAUDE.md: absent

override: "# Override\n\n## Kander Rules Entry\n\nAt the start of every session, read `~/.agents/kander/KANDER-AGENTS.md` and follow it as the Kander workflow rules entry.\n"
uninstall: action=0 path=<HOME>/.codex/AGENTS.md reason="" content="# Main\n"
uninstall: action=0 path=<HOME>/.codex/AGENTS.override.md reason="" content="# Override\n"
== codex-global / override / apply uninstall
apply uninstall plan prompt: "kander uninstall 将处理全局范围：\n  编辑  <HOME>/.codex/AGENTS.md（删除 Kander 加载指令）\n  编辑  <HOME>/.codex/AGENTS.override.md（删除 Kander 加载指令）\n  删除  <HOME>/.agents/kander 中 1 个 Kander 规则文件和状态文件，随后删除变空的目录\n配置：在 <HOME>/.config/kander/config.json 中写入 install_rules: false，并删除所有 agents.<name>.install_rules。\n不删除：二进制、config.json、share 目录、缓存和看板。\n"
apply uninstall: err=false
apply uninstall output: "已关闭规则注入：<HOME>/.config/kander/config.json\n已删除 Kander 加载指令：<HOME>/.codex/AGENTS.md\n已删除 Kander 加载指令：<HOME>/.codex/AGENTS.override.md\n已删除 <HOME>/.agents/kander 中 1 个 Kander 规则文件和状态文件\n"
apply uninstall config: install_rules=false true
apply uninstall file <HOME>/.codex/AGENTS.md: "# Main\n"
apply uninstall file <HOME>/.codex/AGENTS.override.md: "# Override\n"
== project-coverage-order: [claude codex grok cursor pi devin opencode kimi droid]
